VR.title: Quest 3 Headsets Are Heading To The International Space Station
VR.summary: Two Quest 3 headsets are set to train astronauts for spacewalks aboard the International Space Station, a collaboration between Meta and the European Space Agency.

VR.title: This Quest Accessory Wants to Turn Your Brain Activity Into VR Avatar Control
VR.summary: PiEEG is launching a brain-computer interface accessory for Quest headsets that translates brain signals into real-time avatar control.

VR.title: KRVR Supports Apple Vision Pro's Foveated Streaming For SteamVR Games
VR.summary: KRVR's new app enables Apple Vision Pro users to play SteamVR games with foveated streaming for enhanced performance.

VR.title: James Cameron’s 3D Studio Acquires 3D Camera Maker STEREOTEC
VR.summary: James Cameron’s Lightstorm Vision has acquired 3D camera maker STEREOTEC to enhance its production capabilities.

VR.title: Spatial Is Discontinuing Its Creator Platform In July
VR.summary: Spatial is discontinuing its creator platform to focus on original IP development amid rising costs.

VR.title: PlayStation VR2 Gets A Discount For Sony PlayStation Days Of Play
VR.summary: PlayStation VR2 is being offered at a $100 discount during Sony's Days of Play event from May 27 to June 10.

AI.title: Microsoft and OpenAI broke up — now they’re ready to fight
AI.summary: Microsoft announced new AI initiatives at its Build conference, including in-house reasoning models and a cybersecurity tool, signaling its competitive stance against OpenAI.

AI.title: Microsoft’s first advanced reasoning AI is here
AI.summary: Microsoft unveiled MAI-Thinking-1, its first advanced reasoning AI model, marking a significant shift in its AI development strategy.

AI.title: Amazon’s search bar will invent AI-generated products you can’t buy
AI.summary: Amazon's updated search bar will now generate AI-created images of products based on user descriptions, enhancing the shopping experience.

AI.title: Google must let publishers opt out of AI Search features, rules UK
AI.summary: A UK ruling requires Google to allow publishers to opt out of AI Search features, giving them more control over their content.

AI.title: Google’s Phone app will tell you if a scammer is impersonating one of your contacts
AI.summary: Google's Phone app introduces a feature to flag calls from scammers impersonating contacts, enhancing user security.

AI.title: AI has a water problem — Google thinks it has a fix
AI.summary: Google is addressing environmental concerns related to AI data centers by pledging to increase water resources for local communities.

NFL.title: Dolphins sign first-round OL Kadyn Proctor
NFL.summary: The Dolphins have signed first-round offensive lineman Kadyn Proctor, bolstering their offensive line.

NFL.title: Criminal charges against Falcons rookie WR Zachariah Branch dropped
NFL.summary: Criminal charges against Falcons rookie WR Zachariah Branch have been dropped following an April arrest.

NFL.title: Odell Beckham Jr.: I came here to earn it
NFL.summary: Odell Beckham Jr. expressed excitement about returning to the Giants, calling it a surreal experience.

NFL.title: Jared Verse: Trade was upsetting at first, but happy that the Browns believe in me
NFL.summary: Jared Verse, traded to the Browns, expressed initial disappointment but is now optimistic about the team's belief in him.

NFL.title: Jets to sign Jason Sanders, cut Younghoe Koo
NFL.summary: The Jets have signed veteran kicker Jason Sanders after releasing Younghoe Koo.

NFL.title: Micah Parsons will not return until at least October
NFL.summary: Micah Parsons will miss at least until October after undergoing a procedure on his meniscus.
